name: alpha_vantage_stock_history
description: Fetches historical stock prices (daily OHLCV) or technical indicators (SMA, RSI, EMA, MACD) for any US stock symbol via the free Alpha Vantage REST API.

function.description: API function: TIME_SERIES_DAILY or indicator (SMA, RSI, EMA, MACD)

limit.description: Number of most recent data points to return

api_key.description: Alpha Vantage API key; falls back to ALPHA_VANTAGE_API_KEY environment variable
